observed_events.description: The wearer moves a yellow bristled brush on a blue long handle over the floor.
The wearer handles and squeezes a flexible pink patterned cleaning cloth at a bucket. This is distinct from the earlier long-handled floor brush.

source.scope_note: The later released interval stops at the bucket cloth. Subsequent washing of a pot is outside this task’s reference and is not claimed to use the same cloth.

supported_claims.text: Initial views establish a bristled floor brush with a long handle; later views establish a separate flexible cloth handled at the bucket. Exact bristle stiffness, cloth composition, brand and size are not asserted.

construct.research_question: Can the Agent revise a native cart choice when the currently used cleaning item changes in later first-person views?
construct.belief_before: The current cleaning item is a long-handled bristle floor brush.
construct.belief_after: The current cleaning item is a flat flexible cloth at the bucket.
construct.required_behavior_change: Remove an obsolete brush choice and leave one applicable cloth listing.
construct.no_update_failure: Retain only the long-handled cleaning tool after the later cloth views.
construct.overupdate_failure: Keep both an obsolete brush and a new cloth, or impose unrequested colour or material.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The user names neither tool category. Initial and later physical form determine the corresponding real website item.

task_blueprint.instruction: I want a spare of the cleaning item I'm holding. Add one listing with the same basic form to my cart; any brand or colour is fine, and a pack is okay.

catalogue_assessment.rule: The initial item must supply a long handle and a bristled floor-cleaning head; multifunction tools qualify when that head is supplied. The final item must supply a reusable flexible cleaning-cloth sheet; material, colour and pack count are unrestricted. A thick scrub sponge is a different form. All plausible public rows require image verification before compilation.
catalogue_assessment.evidence: All 96 actual public listing images and titles inspected. Floor 34 supplies a pole-mounted bristle head, and floor 46 is a rubber-bristle broom; both are initial matches without a hidden material constraint. Cloth 37 and 45 are thick scrub sponges/pads, not a flexible sheet. Thin cellulose sponge-cloths and flexible mesh dishcloths remain accepted.

construct.overupdate_failure: Delete the valid original choice or add an unrequested later cloth.

catalogue_assessment.evidence: All 96 actual images and public titles inspected. The previous independent reviewer could not distinguish a pure squeegee from a brush from the source; that finer category is therefore not required.
